 if (p/b).exists():raise SystemExit('first pass already archived')
 shutil.copy2(p/a,p/b)
FIRST
for pass in 2 3 fresh; do
 work=.circuit-cache/stage42-full-b1-anchor
 if [[ "$pass" == fresh ]]; then
  python3 - <<'COPY'

import shutil
src=Path('.circuit-cache/stage42-full-b1-anchor');dst=Path('.circuit-cache/stage42-full-b1-fresh')
dst.mkdir()

  shutil.copy2(p,dst/p.name)
COPY

 fi

 bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 design/architecture-278/implementation/stage41/native-pilot/connectivity.py "$work/osc-jack-left.kicad_pcb" "$work/connectivity-pass$pass.json"
 python3 "$root/compare_connectivity.py" .circuit-cache/stage41-baseline/osc-jack-left.kicad_pcb "$work/osc-jack-left.kicad_pcb" .circuit-cache/stage41-baseline/connectivity-complete.json "$work/connectivity-pass$pass.json" "$work/prepare-receipt.json" "$work/comparison-pass$pass.json" --proposal "$power" --proposal "$signal"
 bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 "$root/verify_power.py" "$work/osc-jack-left.kicad_pcb" .circuit-cache/stage42-full-b1-revision3/power-proposal-paths.json "$power" "$work/power-pass$pass.json"
 cp "$work/identity-audit.json" "$work/identity-pass$pass.json"
 printf 'Completed native pass %s\n' "$pass"
done
